		Meddies PII v3 Skeleton
	


	
		
	
	
		Overview
	

This dataset contains 404,635 document templates across 20 languages. They cover 6 layouts, 17 text formats, and 156 document types. Typed placeholders mark where values from 9 main entity categories go.

Use at your own risk. Synthetic data isn’t a substitute for testing on real records.
